The number of corners with the geometric threshold of 0.5 on the three images of the figure. The rectangle is 100 x 140 pixels at 200 on a ground of 40, so any threshold well below the step of 160 finds its four corners, at the corner pixels themselves, with the response 5.5 and a USAN area of 13 of 37.
